title: Embedding model switch: telemetry gating, compatibility safeguards, and phased retirements
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a safe, observable process for onboarding new embedding models and retiring old variants behind the embeddings and reranking endpoints. The goal is to ensure quality parity or improvement, meet latency/throughput SLOs, and provide automated rollback gates driven by telemetry and per-tenant risk profiles.
background: We are adding two new candidate embedding variants (m-embed-v4 and m-embed-v4-quant) and need a standard runbook for: canary traffic split, per-tenant opt-in, fallback routing, deprecation timeline for legacy models, and automation for toggling model variants based on SLIs. Past tickets focused on embedding versioning and canary strategies but lacked a concise telemetry-driven gating mechanism and a tenant-aware rollback policy.
proposed_solution: 1) Add a model variant descriptor that includes compatibility metadata (vector dim, normalization, tokenization hints, semantic drift fingerprint). 2) Extend the routing layer to support percent-based canaries with tenant allowlists and time-based wind-up. 3) Implement a telemetry rule engine that consumes probe queries, embedding similarity deltas, latency/CPU trends, and quality regressions (R-precision on sentinel prompt sets) to auto-pause rollout if thresholds breached. 4) Add documented deprecation cadence and a tenant migration CLI for forced remap with audit logging.
rollout_plan:
- Phase 0 (Prep): build descriptors, add metrics to embed pipeline, create sentinel prompt set for key use-cases.
- Phase 1 (Internal Canary): route 1% of infra-team traffic to new variants, collect 7 days of telemetry.
- Phase 2 (Tenant Canary): enable 2-5 strategic tenants with explicit opt-in, monitor per-tenant SLI for 14 days.
- Phase 3 (Ramp): increase traffic at 2x/week increments up to 50% with automated gating.
- Phase 4 (Cutover): switch default alias, schedule deprecation windows for legacy variants with 90-day notice.
- Rollback: immediate fallback to previous variant if telemetry rules fire; create incident and post-mortem.
telemetry_and_sli: Key SLIs: median and 95th percentile embed generation latency, token-level CPU/GPU utilization, R-precision and MAP on sentinel prompt set, cosine similarity distribution shifts, and tail failure rate. Telemetry will surface per-tenant and global views. Rules: pause rollout if: (a) R-precision drop >5% for any tenant, (b) 95th latency increases >30ms, (c) error rate spike >0.5% sustained for 10 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Model descriptor schema defined and stored in model-catalog (includes compatibility fields)
Routing supports percent canary with tenant allowlist and persistent aliasing
Telemetry pipeline reports per-variant SLIs and exposes rules for auto-pause
Sentinel prompt set covers at least 6 distinct production use-cases and is versioned
Automated rollback executes within 60s and is auditable ( logs + PR reference )
Decommission CLI exists to remap tenant aliases and emits audit entries
Runbook doc published with contact list and checklist for manual intervention
